Element.attribute:
Responsible for gathering and analyzing business requirements as well as designing the future state Oracle solution based on the results of the fit gap analysis between the requirements and the base out-of-the-box Oracle functionality and EY's pre-solutioned assets.

The workstream also completes standard configurations and actively supports testing, training design and development and cutover readiness activities.

Element.DisplayName: EY Accelerate (EYA) Methodology for Oracle Services
Element.Name: eya_oracle_methodology
gather_information
Element.attribute: Review the request for proposal (RFP) and begin populating the requirements traceability matrix (RTM). Gather any additional information needed to better understand the client's current and desired business capabilities and supporting processes.

Element.Name: confirm_target_bus_capab
Element.attribute: Meet with key client stakeholders to confirm the business capabilities that will be part of the future state. Begin identifying the out-of-the-box Oracle process flows and EY pre-solutioned assets needed to enable the in-scope capabilities.

Element.Name: prepare_fit_gap_workshops
Element.attribute: Based on the in-scope business capabilities, schedule workshops with key client stakeholders to analyze whether the associated out-of-the-box Oracle business process flows meet the requirements of the business.

Element.Name: define_business_requirements
Element.attribute: Gather future state business requirements from key client stakeholders based on the in-scope business capabilities.

Element.Name: define_mstr_bus_proc_inv
Element.attribute: Confirm with key client stakeholders the complete set of out-of-the-box Oracle business processes and any EY pre-solutioned process assets that will be included in the target state and identify client process owners.

Element.Name: map_rqmt_bus_process
Element.DisplayName: Map requirements to business process flows

Element.Name: conduct_fit_gap_workshops
Element.attribute: During each of the fit gap workshop sessions, walk the client stakeholders through the Oracle standard (out-of-the-box base) process flows as well as EY's pre-solutioned business process assets and determine their fit to the client's requirements.

Element.Name: review_base_proc_flows_assets
Element.DisplayName: Review base process flows and assets

Element.Name: review_rqmt_map_base_proc
Element.DisplayName: Review requirements and mapping to base processes

Element.Name: conduct_bus_proc_elab_ws
Element.attribute: For requirements that are a partial fit or no fit to Oracle's standard process flows and EY's pre-solutioned assets, conduct process elaboration workshops to further analyze the gaps, discuss alternatives and finalize next steps.

Element.Name: create_mas_config_wb
Element.attribute: Define the configurations that are needed to enable the in-scope business processes in the target state and document any necessary steps, values and screenshots.

Element.Name: create_mas_eicefw_inv
Element.attribute: Inventory the RICEFW (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) objects that need to be developed to enable the requirements that can not be met by standard out-of-the-box Oracle functionality or EY pre-solutioned business process assets.

Element.Name: document_repo_specfic
Element.attribute: For the in-scope reports, document the specifications needed to implement the reports in the future state. Include the relevant data sources and where possible, provide mock-ups.

Element.Name: document_func_design_spec
Element.attribute: For the in-scope RICEFW (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) objects, document how the custom developed objects should function in the target state solution.

Element.Name: perform_configurations
Element.attribute: Complete the in-scope configurations needed to implement the target state Oracle solution.
